english:
Kneel. Again, the prayer: "Our Lord Jesus Christ." And at the completion: "Son of God." Hymn, Tone 3 [gd]: "He Who Flowed from Above" (Որ ի վերայ բղխեալ). Prayer together with it. Again, the prayer: "You Who are Lord." And at the completion: "Spirit of God." And the rest according to the order.

But in the evening at the tenth hour, they shall gather in the church.
Psalm 142 [143]: "Let your good spirit..."
Acts 2:1 to the end, verse 21: "...of the Lord shall be saved."
Gospel according to John 15:26: "But when..." to 16:14: "...and declare it to you."
And they shall go forth with the Cross and the Gospel and all adornments in procession, singing the hymn, Tone 8 [dd]: "The Dove Sent Forth" (Առաքելոյ աղաւնւոյ).
After this, "Orthios" [Stand].
Gospel according to John 16:16: "A little while and no..." to verse 32: "...because the Father is with me."
Hymn, Tone 8 [dd]: "Life-Giving God" (Կենդանարար աստուած).
Gospel according to John 16:33: "These things I have spoken to you..." to 17:12: "...that the scripture might be fulfilled."
Hymn, Tone 2 [bd]: "Same and Image" (Նոյն եւ նման).
Gospel according to John 17:13: "But now I come to you..." to 18:1: "...and His disciples."
And they shall sign the four corners of the world [Antasdan].
Litany: "By this Holy Cross" (Սուրբ խաչիւս).
Prayer: "Keeper" (Պահպանեա).
And then: "Incline" [Psalm 85/86] and "Deliver" [Psalm 139/140].
Mesedi: "Your throne..." "Has overflowed..."
Litany: "Let us say" (Ասասցուք).
Hambartsi [Evening Hymn], Tone 4 [bk]: "Trinity" (Երրորդութիւն).
Prayer: "Compassionate Father" (Հայր գթած).
Dismissal Psalm 150: "Praise God..."
Gospel according to John 14:15: "If you love me..." to verse 24: "...who sent me."
After this, hymn, Tone 3 [gd]: "You Who are Co-essential" (Որ համագոյդ).
And then they shall read the prayer of Nerses of Lambron, which he spoke for the glory of the coming of the All-Holy Spirit of God: "I am constrained by love" (Ստիպիմ ի սիրոյ).
At the completion:
Litany: "Giving thanks..." "Save [us]" (Կեցո).
Prayer: "By Your peace, Holy Spirit God..."
And then, the Fast of Elijah.

During these six days, Saint Nerses the Graceful [Shnorhali] established the celebration of the Feast of the Coming of the Holy Spirit, and adorned it with songs and readings. But the five days of this week are an unbreakable fast.

Monday. Tone 2 [bd]: "Same and Image" (Նոյն եւ նման), with its proper canons [sarokn].
Alleluia, Psalm: "The wings of a dove..." "When compiling..."
Response: "You send forth your spirit..." "May the glory be..."
Morning Psalm 103 [104], Antiphon: "You send forth..." Response: "Bless, my soul..."
Genesis 1:1: "In the beginning God created..." to verse 5: "...the morning, one day."
Proverbs 9:1: "Wisdom built..." to verse 6: "...understanding by knowledge."
Acts 10:44: "And while he was speaking..." to verse 48: "...of Jesus Christ."
Alleluia, Psalm 28 [29]: "The voice of the Lord is upon the waters."
Gospel according to Matthew 3:16: "And when he was baptized..." to 4:2: "...then he was hungry."
Song: "Of Creation" (Արարչական).
Litany: "Let us ask..."
Prayer: "To Your All-Powerful..."
Midday Entry [Zhamamut]: "Today in fiery..." Response: "The Lord reigns."
Hymn, Tone 3 [gd]: "Same and Image of the Father..." — say both together.
The Apostle, Romans 1:1: "Paul, a servant..." to verse 17: "...shall live by faith."
Alleluia, Psalm 94 [95]: "Come, let us rejoice."
Gospel according to Matthew 7:28: "And it came to pass when..." to 8:4: "...for a testimony to them."

In the Evening:
First Psalm 104 [105]: "You send forth your spirit..." Response: "Bless..."
Gospel according to John 14:15: "If you love me..." to verse 24: "...who sent me."
Mesedi: "The Lord reigns..." "They appeared..."
Hambartsi [Evening Hymn], Tone 4 [bk]: "Today the Heavenly Beings..."
Dismissal Psalm 28 [29]: "The voice of the Lord..." Response: "Bring to the Lord..."
Gospel according to Matthew 3:16: "And when he was baptized..." to 4:2: "...then he was hungry."
Litany: "Giving thanks..." "Save [us]" (Կեցո).
Prayer: "With peace" (Խաղաղութեամբ).

Tuesday. Tone 4 [bk]: "Today the Heavenly Beings..." with its proper canons.
Alleluia, Psalm 97 [98]: "I have found David..." "My hand..."
Response: "The manifestation of words..." "My mouth..."
Morning Psalm 32 [33]: "By mercy..." Response: "Rejoice..."
Genesis 8:6: "And it came to pass after..." to verse 11: "...in her mouth."
Proverbs [Book of Wisdom] 1:5: "For the Holy Spirit..." to verse 7: "...filled the universe."
Acts 13:1: "And there were some..." to verse 5: "...they preached the word."
Psalm 147: "Praise, O Jerusalem."
Gospel according to John 1:29: "The next day..." to verse 34: "...this is the Son of God."
Midday Entry [Zhamamut]: "Wherefore we also..."
Hymn, Tone 4 [bk]: "Today the Heavenly Beings..."
Psalm 5: "I will worship..." Response: "Let them boast..."
